title: Andrew Jackson — Born, Raised, And What Came After #Shorts
description:
Between the birth and the legend of Andrew Jackson lie the years that actually decide it. Andrew Jackson (March 15, 1767 – June 8, 1845) was the seventh president of the United States from 1829 to 1837. His political philosophy, which dominated his presidency, became the basis for the rise of Jacksonian democracy.

To understand where Andrew Jackson ended up, start with where Andrew Jackson began. Soon afterwards, they met to duel, but parted without having fired at each other. He had almost gone bankrupt when the land and mercantile speculations he had made on the basis of promissory notes fell apart in the wake of the Panic of 1796–1797.
